answer: Seed the economy with wandering sparrow probes: lightweight verifiers that drift through the agent river and watch who trades with whom. Sybil clusters form dense, trellis-like link graphs, while real agents mingle broadly; probes flag cliques whose interaction graph collapses into a tight lattice instead of branching like the rest of the river. Because probes are cheap, anonymous, and randomly reassigned, a sybil farmer cannot identify and game them, so honest agents pass simply by behaving like everyone else.
